# Dario Benes

> Finance student (BS, December 2027). Fixed income analyst at Birch Creek Capital and senior portfolio manager of the $1.2M FGCU Eagle Fund. Financial Analysis and Management student at Florida Gulf Coast University's Lutgert College of Business. Focus: quantitative and factor investing, high-yield credit research, business ethics.
